title: V1 - Profile, Quote, Readiness
description: Clean intake flow that creates an initial profile, readiness score, quote range, confidence level, and recommended package.

title: V2 - Internal Workspace and Gap Analysis
description: Internal RainTech customer workspace for profile review, editing, and CMMC Level 2 gap analysis.

title: V3 - Evidence Capture
description: Integrated manual evidence capture, evidence library, many-to-many objective mapping, lifecycle actions, and ZIP export.

title: V4 - Reports
description: Readiness, gap, POA&M/status, and evidence capture reports.

title: V5 - Documents
description: SSP, policies, procedures, and diagrams generated from templates and the final implementation profile.

title: V6 - Hosted Platform and RBAC
description: Hosted platform security, authentication, authorization, tenant boundaries, and operations.

title: V7 - Customer Portal
description: Customer-facing login for reports, tasks, requests, and limited collaboration.

title: V8 - Automated Evidence
description: Evidence automation from common systems such as M365, Huntress, Autotask, SharePoint, Entra, Intune, and Defender.
